_about: The physical tree (skills 201..214) without the two stock skills nothing can learn (the owner, 2026-11-06), as the original developers did by 0.46c2: Sledgehammer (206, st_meele_hit_ultimate_name, 3 ranks, meele_hit_ultimate_modifier, ui.position [4, 2]) and Jump with a knife (210, st_meele_hit_range_name, 0 ranks, meele_hit_range_modifier, ui.position [4, 3]). Both ask for branch_points 50, past the 25 the skills window's walk unlocks (CharWindow.getBranchUnlockedLevel, SKILL_LEVELS 25), so no account ever held a point in them; their two modifiers are not among the exe's 68 (table 0x928448). Both are in 0.31a2's skills_tree, absent from 0.46c2's; 0.69 keeps only their strings. Their localization strings stay. Removed (remove_entry, by id). With them gone column 4 of the physical tree is empty, so Packrat (209, max_carried_weight, branch_points 5, row 2) moves from column 3 to column 4 of its own row (ui.position [column, row]: [3, 2] -> [4, 2], Sledgehammer's place): its row, threshold, ranks and modifiers are as before. Presentation only: no point of an account changes.
